description.en: CANNBot Harness: Ascend development workbench with independently versioned workflow packages
DSH Flash 精简预设：两个 agent 预设（精简·PTC v3（lean-v3），flash-lean-ptc-v3，13 条规则，默认；精简·PTC v3 balance，flash-lean-ptc-v3-balance，3 条规则），以 DSH 组合包（dsh.bundle）形式安装到 profile，并附带计划模式组件（plan-mode v1）。
CANNBot Harness: Ascend development workbench with independently versioned workflow packages

Live DeepSeek API token price bar for the web GUI: peak/off-peak tariff, UTC + local (Quebec) clocks, countdown to the next tariff change, and a daily self-verification against the official DeepSeek pricing page.

Plugin-authoring skill for DeepSeek Harness: the distilled anatomy, client-UI recipe, slots, locale, theme tokens, install steps, gotchas, and validation checklist for building and publishing new DSH plugins.
DSH 网页版桌面宠物「肥鲸」——蓝发鲸鱼娘，固定在 harness 页面右下角：会眨眼、能拖拽、点击可聊天，支持语音对话、念诗说书、饭点提醒。
Use ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok, Antigravity, Kimi, GLM, Cursor, Kiro, Copilot, Qwen, ERNIE, Spark, JetBrains, Perplexity, Replit, and Cody subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers via OAuth.
DSH 远程隧道云官方客户端插件：一条命令把本机 DeepSeek Harness 接入云端隧道（设备码绑定、短期令牌、本地门禁代理、HTTP/SSE/WebSocket 反向隧道）。
AI 写作工作台：远程Claude与Codex（主机常驻进程，经 aw-acp 接回），员工电脑文件由主机 agent 经 ssh 操作。
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立的图像生成与编辑 Skill、工具和设置界面。
在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中以会话级 artifact 安全展示交互式 HTML 可视化。
群聊页面：侧边栏一个图标，点开是三条鱼的群（读写 lil-whale\group\messages.jsonl）

Delegate independent tasks to the local Antigravity CLI (agy) from DSH; non-official plugin with a self-contained AGY runtime, startup/stall watchdogs, status and cancel control, and eight-language UI.
Free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native dsh-llm adapter plugin, no API key.
Cordis plugin: image/video backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.
PM工作台（Agile Workbench）套装 bundle：一次安装装齐工作台启动器、记忆插件、浏览器插件、搜索插件、视觉插件与安全搜索 MCP。
A precise, safe code editor inside DSH's native file tabs.
DSH 生图插件：在设置中配置多个生图供应商/模型，并在对话中通过 image_generate 调用当前选中的模型。
Aident CLI — umbrella access to Loadout integrations, Playbook automation, Intern tools, and the Aident platform.
Delegate from DeepSeek Harness Web to existing Codex CLI, Codex Desktop and Claude Code sessions with progress and completion callbacks.
A2A protocol for DSH: expose a DSH Session as a standard A2A agent, call remote A2A agents, and run invite-only collaboration groups where a group is itself an A2A agent behind a gateway.
把 AI 的情绪搬到模型外面：若干条情绪轴各 0-100，按你说的话加减、随时间自己漂移，每轮把「现在处在哪一档 + 可用标签」注入系统提示。数值只由插件维护，模型自己算不出来也改不了——它只能带着这个状态说话。
Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作 + 原生视觉模型接入（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 直读截图），screen_observe 等 20 个模型友好工具；浏览器组 browser_* 为兜底
Agent-team runtime for DeepSeek Harness: seeded-fork subagent generations, a durable lineage journal, and a point-to-point mail server so members can message each other
灵枢（Lingshu·líng shū）DeepSeek Harness 插件：完整大脑——长期记忆/知识飞轮/自我认知/递归反思接入 DSH，对话自动沉淀进 md_cg 认知图（md 文档）
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a session cost chip in the conversation header - live token usage by bucket, peak/off-peak tariff, and a countdown to the next tariff switch.
Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.

DeepSeek Harness 换肤插件（Dream Skin for DSH）：8 套 iOS / Linear 式清透冷调的高质感主题 + 弥散光壁纸 + 每皮肤智能背景 + 强调色 + 主题包分享，把换肤做成材质与配色克制的高级感工艺，而非贴图。Works in native DSH Web and third-party desktop clients (DSH Desktop): 8 original premium themes, glass materials, wallpaper 2.0, per-user accent, shareable theme packs — p…
DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。
DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。

MC 模组工坊：在 DeepSeek Harness 里从想法到可运行的 Minecraft 模组——支持 Java 版全版本（Forge / NeoForge / Fabric / Quilt，1.7.10 到 26.x，版本目录实时取自各家官方元数据）与基岩版附加包（行为包 + 资源包 + @minecraft/server 脚本，打包 .mcaddon）；需求对话、会诊（多视角评审挑刺 + 互相反驳 + 头脑风暴）、环境安装、脚手架、贴图与模型生成、构建、GameTest、真机自动测试、资产预览（贴图 2D / 模型 3D 自动旋转 / jar）、分支（子系统拆到独立会话做、做完一键并…
Vibe coding时的好伴侣

Cut token cost without cutting model intelligence — a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle plugin: structure-aware compression + TOON-style lossless encoding first + reversible spill-to-disk + real-time dashboard.
尽可能的使dsh适配竖屏等移动端设备
DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.
鲸编程 - 不只是手机遥控操作电脑,而是将电脑级的Agent能力装进手机

Monitor BI 报表工作室:左侧导航栏独立入口,点进去就是 Harness 原生对话,但该房间只做 Monitor BI 报表(上下文干净、不与日常对话混杂)。自带零安装 CLI 工具链、操作手册、模板、数据字典;首次使用自动询问连接信息。A clean, sidebar-entry BI-only room for DeepSeek Harness with bundled tools, manual, templates and dictionary.

Monitor 数据搬运工作室:左侧导航独立入口,把一个 Monitor 公司的数据(主数据/BOM/未结订单/库存快照/附加字段)经官方 API 搬进另一个 Monitor 系统,跨版本不动表结构/角色/权限。自带进程内引擎(源库直读+目标API写入)与操作手册。A sidebar-entry data transfer studio for DeepSeek Harness: moves one Monitor company into another via official APIs only.

Share this machine's Ollama models on the GenKaKu network

Presmium's bundle for DeepSeek Harness: the workbench of presmium studio, its host side (Presmium's tools, approvals, document context, skills and routes) and its client side (the root layout and the workbench's panels, precompiled) (experimental)

Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects three per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls, self-repeating low-entropy reasoning) and re-fires instead of latching; plus three mid-stream breakers that end …
AI Shell brand reskin for DSH web — replaces sidebar and hero brand marks with AI Shell SVG
DSH-only persisted source-turn memory: plugin-owned SQLite, entity ranking, global/project dedup, local/remote Jev, history reads/stats/backfill and Obsidian. / 仅持久化 DSH 会话源 turn 召回、插件自有索引及历史管理。

Put your own image where the DSH Web GUI's sidebar brand mark goes (client half, sidebar.brand.mark) and override the page favicon (host half via webServer.tapIndex). Ships default icons in lib/; set config.iconPath to use your own PNG.
DSH plugin: per-model proxy routing (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI — e.g. opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor needs a proxy while sibling models stay direct

A task progress bar for the DSH Web GUI. Host-inject mode: the host half serves /dsh-progress-bar/state and injects plain JS through webserver/index-inject; it deliberately declares no client half. The progress source defaults to $DSH_HOME/dsh-progress/state.json (override with the PROGRESS_BAR_STA…
花语乡 Project Bloom 的 DeepSeek Harness 适配版：独立的 DSH 居民生活、工作与娱乐插件

Windows XP skin for the DSH Web GUI. Host-inject mode ONLY: injects CSS and a plain-DOM taskbar through webserver/index-inject. It deliberately does NOT declare dsh.client: measured 2026-09-26, adding a client half that registers nothing still emptied the single-occupancy sidebar.brand.mark slot an…
